name: Jaaziah
overview: Jaaziah is a male descendant of Merari from the tribe of Levi, specifically belonging to the Merarite clan. This lineage identifies him as part of the Levitical family responsible for particular duties in the service of the tabernacle. The Merarites were known for their role in carrying and caring for the structural components of the tabernacle, highlighting Jaaziah's heritage within a tribe set apart for sacred service.
namesAndTitles: The name Jaaziah means 'may YHWH nourish,' reflecting a prayerful invocation of God's sustaining grace. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 24:26, reveals a connection to divine provision and blessing, consistent with the Levitical emphasis on serving God faithfully.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jaaziah as a descendant of Merari and lists his direct paternal lineage through Ibri, Zaccur, Shoham, and Beno, establishing a clear genealogical line within the Merarite branch of the Levites. These relationships affirm his place within a specific Levitical family entrusted with sacred responsibilities.
scriptureSignificance: Jaaziah's significance lies in his identification as part of the Merarite lineage, a key division among the Levites who were assigned particular duties in the organization of temple service. His genealogy in 1 Chronicles 24:27 underscores the orderly arrangement God established for worship and service, demonstrating the importance of faithful lineage and divine appointment in the life of Israel. Through Jaaziah and his ancestors, we see the continuity of God's covenant people dedicated to His holy work.
